appearance.subtle: A cut on their hand is already closing.
appearance.obvious: A fresh wound on their forearm is knitting shut as you look at it, pink and working.
appearance.extreme: Their flesh crawls constantly, closing and reforming. Something opened them earlier today and there is no mark left to say where.

description: Your body has stopped accepting damage as permanent. Wounds close while you watch, and the process is not pleasant to be inside.
drawbacks: Healing hurts more than the wound
name: Regenerative Flesh
